video_title: IT'S A WRAP if the Knicks go up 2-0 vs. the Spurs! 😮 - Stephen A. looks ahead to Game 2 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith warns the Knicks about Game 2
quotes.excerpt: He put the Knicks on high alert. Be ready, because I'm coming for Game 2.
quotes.quote: He put the Knicks on high alert. Be ready, because I'm coming for Game 2. Which means that if the New York Knicks respond even more forcefully, that's going to elevate my confidence even more that the Knicks are going to win the chip.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Spurs' resilience in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Every time the Spurs have been challenged this postseason, they have responded.
quotes.quote: Every time the Spurs have been challenged this postseason, they have responded. They had that game in their hand last night. Jalen Brunson took it. They did not give it away. The Knicks took it, but I can understand why he is feeling confident.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Knicks' comfort level against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks are comfortable playing against the Spurs. Jalen Brunson is comfortable playing against Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: The Knicks are comfortable playing against the Spurs. Jalen Brunson is comfortable playing against Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Victor Wembanyama's emotional fatigue
quotes.excerpt: He was tired because emotionally, he's still learning how to check himself.
quotes.quote: He was tired because emotionally, he's still learning how to check himself because it's the NBA Finals. He's hyped for the whole bit, and then you go up against a Nick team that's determined to take you down. There is a difference between going up against a Chet Holmgren who looked petrified. We're going to call it like we see it. He looked absolutely petrified on the basketball court.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on Karl-Anthony Towns' impact in Game 7
quotes.excerpt: There is no way on earth that Karl-Anthony Towns and the New York Knicks looked at Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: There is no way on earth that Karl-Anthony Towns and the New York Knicks looked at Wembanyama in that Game 7 and Karl-Anthony Towns did not say, 'Hell no, that ain't going to be me.' There is no way in hell I'm going to play like that. There is no way in hell I'm going to be that passive, that impotent offensively.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Spurs needing to play Wembanyama more
quotes.excerpt: He might need to actually play more because when they put Luke Kornet on the court.
quotes.quote: He might need to actually play more because when they put Luke Kornet on the court yesterday, and something that Mike Brown did, whether it was specifically planned or it just worked out, he had Jalen Brunson coming off the bench as Victor Wembanyama was going to it, twice. And Brunson smelled weakness and crushed Kornet to the point where Mitch Johnson had to rush Wembanyama back in the game in the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on the pressure facing the Spurs in Game 2
quotes.excerpt: It's definitely the San Antonio Spurs. You can't go down 0-2.
quotes.quote: It's definitely the San Antonio Spurs. You can't go down 0-2. I don't give a damn how good this team is. I'm telling you right now.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith's warning about the Spurs potentially getting swept
quotes.excerpt: If the San Antonio Spurs lose Game 2 and go down 0-2, you might get swept.
quotes.quote: If the San Antonio Spurs lose Game 2 and go down 0-2, you might get swept. You might get swept. I'm telling you right now, it's that deep. You can't, I didn't imagine that the New York Knicks would win two games in San Antonio.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Knicks' recent struggles
quotes.excerpt: They've lost four games since March.
quotes.quote: They've lost four games since March. And two of the games in the playoffs were by one point. So if you lose tomorrow, you're going to win this championship, you're going to beat them four times in five games? No way. That ain't happening.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on the magnitude of Game 2
quotes.excerpt: I am not blind, even though I picked the Knicks to win the series. I know San Antonio could win it.
quotes.quote: I am not blind, even though I picked the Knicks to win the series. I know San Antonio could win it. I know you can't dismiss them. You can't rule them out, unless they go down 0-2. If you go down 0-2, it's a wrap.
